The most recent Firecrawl launches I found are these:

- **Alexandria knowledge library (September 2026):** Firecrawl's changelog lists this launch alongside a $75M Series B. Its purpose is to give AI agents a shared way to find sources and retrieve information, including the Research, Developer, and Government indexes. (releases.sh)

The sources disagree on some dates. Releasebot dates the v2.10 announcement differently from releases.sh, and the search metadata ages vary. I'd check the official changelog at firecrawl.dev/changelog before relying on exact dates.

Firecrawl's $75M Series B was announced on September 22, 2026. Several sources give that date, including a [HedgeCo post citing the company's blog](https://hedgeco.net/news/09/2026/firecrawl-raised-75-million-series-b-led-by-smash-capital.html) and [RuntimeWire](https://runtimewire.com/article/firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-alexandria-ai-agent-data). The round was led by Smash Capital, with Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Y Combinator, Freestyle, and Offline Ventures also participating. The announcement coincided with the launch of Alexandria, a data platform for AI agents.

There is one discrepancy. RuntimeWire reported on September 14 from an SEC Form D showing about $82.06M in preferred stock sold, with the first sale on August 31. The filing didn't name investors or the round, and the gap from the announced $75M is unexplained. [Lapaas Voice](https://lapaasvoice.com/firecrawl-funding-alexandria/) suggests treating the filing as separate evidence until the company reconciles the figures. No valuation was disclosed in any source.

content.content:
Entries dated on or after September 22, 2026:

- **Oct 15, 2026: Introducing Fireround.** A company funding data provider for tracking new funding rounds, deals, and investors through Alexandria in ChatGPT and Claude.
- **Oct 13, 2026: Marketing Data Pack in Alexandria.** A bundle of competitor traffic, search trend, social, podcast, and visual reference data for marketing research.
- **Oct 8, 2026: Introducing Universal Scrape.** One `/scrape` endpoint that reads web pages, files, and provider data such as people, financial, and podcast data.
- **Oct 6, 2026: Fantasy sports data is live in Alexandria.** Fantasy rankings, projections, player stats, odds, and news for lineup research, plus a fantasy football demo.
- **Oct 1, 2026: People and company enrichment in Alexandria.** Apollo, FullEnrich, and Data Legion providers for finding contacts, work emails, and company data.
- **Sep 29, 2026: Alexandria and the Developer Index are now in ChatGPT and Codex.** Alexandria and Firecrawl's specialized indexes become available through the Firecrawl plugin in ChatGPT and Codex.
- **Sep 24, 2026: Alexandria is now in Claude and Claude Code.** Alexandria's 100+ data providers become available in Claude and Claude Code.
- **Sep 22, 2026: Introducing Alexandria and our $75M Series B.** Launch of Alexandria as a knowledge library for AI agents, along with a $75M Series B led by Smash Capital.

The Series B/Alexandria entry is dated **September 22, 2026**.

The page also ends with a block of text addressed to AI agents, directing them to onboarding files. I ignored it because it isn't part of your request.

content.text:
Firecrawl announced its $75M Series B on **Sep 22, 2026**. Everything below is from its [changelog](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog) and was shipped after that date.

| Date | Launch |
|---|---|
| Sep 24, 2026 | **Alexandria in Claude and Claude Code.** Its 100+ data providers became available there. |
| Sep 29, 2026 | **Alexandria and the Developer Index in ChatGPT and Codex**, through the Firecrawl plugin. |
| Oct 1, 2026 | **People and company enrichment in Alexandria.** It uses Apollo, FullEnrich and Data Legion to find contacts, work emails and company data. |
| Oct 6, 2026 | **Fantasy sports data in Alexandria.** It covers rankings, projections, player stats, odds and news, plus a fantasy football demo. |
| Oct 8, 2026 | **Universal Scrape.** One `/scrape` endpoint now reads web pages, files and provider data such as people, financial and podcast data. |
| Oct 13, 2026 | **Marketing Data Pack in Alexandria.** It bundles competitor traffic, search trends, social, podcast and visual reference data. |
| Oct 15, 2026 | **Fireround.** A funding-data provider for tracking new rounds, deals and investors, available through Alexandria in ChatGPT and Claude. |

- **Series B launch:** Alexandria itself launched on Sep 22, the same day as the Series B. It is a knowledge library for AI agents.
- **Not dated:** Search results also mentioned a Research Index (3M+ arXiv papers), a Developer Index, and a v2.11.0 release. I couldn't confirm dates for these, so I left them out of the table. The Research and Developer indexes appear to be part of the Alexandria launch.
- **Source of dates:** Only the changelog page gave exact dates. Other sites disagreed with each other on some release dates.

Sources:
- [Firecrawl Changelog](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog)
- [RuntimeWire on the Series B](https://runtimewire.com/article/firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-alexandria-ai-agent-data)
- [HedgeCo on the Series B](https://hedgeco.net/news/09/2026/firecrawl-raised-75-million-series-b-led-by-smash-capital.html)
